text:
Ravi - New Hire: Hey team, just unboxed my MBP. During setup the screen showed "Enrolling device... verifying device identity" for ages. Post-login I see no profile and FileVault toggle is grayed out. Also can't add my SSH key to ~/.ssh (permission denied). Anyone seen this?
Lina (IT): Welcome Ravi! Quick checks: can you paste your serial and run `profiles status -type enrollment` and `fdesetup status`? Also `whoami` and `id -Gn` so I can see if you're in admin group.
Ravi - New Hire: Serial S0L1D2R3V4. Outputs:
```
Serial: S0L1D2R3V4
profiles: No enrolled profiles
fdesetup: FileVault is Off
whoami: ravi
id -Gn: staff
```
Ravi - New Hire: sudo prompts for a password but my Okta password doesn't work here.
Harper - EngInfra: Ok that means device didn't complete DEP handshake. If Jamf/DEP token was stale we'd see this. Ravi, run `sudo log show --predicate 'process == "mdmclient"' --last 10m | tail -n 40` and paste the last few lines.
Ravi - New Hire: Pasted: `mdmclient: certificate validation failed: 401 token expired`
Deploy Bot: Ticket TICKET-2044 created and assigned to eng-infra. ETA 1h.
Harper - EngInfra: Yep, 401 token expired. I'm renewing the Apple DEP token and pushing a re-enroll for your serial now. In parallel @Lina can you approve temporary local admin for Ravi so he can finish dev setup?
Marta (People Ops): Approve temporary admin for 3 hours for ravi@redwood.com. Manager (Harper) confirmed.
Lina (IT): Temp admin granted. You should see admin privileges after a logout/login. Use sudo for installs; we'll revoke when enrollment finishes.
Ravi - New Hire: I see admin now, able to chown ~/.ssh and add keys. Docker installed. Thanks.
Harper - EngInfra: DEP token renewed and Jamf re-enroll pushed for S0L1D2R3V4. Reboot when convenient and accept the Remote Management prompt. I'll monitor the mdmclient logs.
Harper - EngInfra: Follow-up log shows successful handshake and profile applied. Pushing FileVault profile now.
Ravi - New Hire: Rebooted and saw Remote Management prompt, accepted. `profiles` now lists MDM profile. FileVault shows "Enabling" after restart.
Deploy Bot: TICKET-2044 updated: DEP token renewed by eng-infra, profile applied to device S0L1D2R3V4, FileVault command queued. Temporary admin scheduled to auto-revoke in 3 hours.
Lina (IT): Confirmed recovery key escrowed in Jamf. I'll revoke the temp admin once FileVault shows enabled.
Ravi - New Hire: FileVault finished enabling and SSH keys working. Admin flag gone. All set for my first-day checklist. Thanks y'all! :tada:
Marta (People Ops): Welcome aboard Ravi! If anything else pops up DM IT or reopen TICKET-2044.
